title: SQL built by concatenation (scala) — review required
description: A scala query call assembles SQL from parts: SQLs*([^)]*+. If any part is untrusted input, the query structure itself is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Parameterize with SQL with .on() bindings so input stays data; never interpolate values into SQL text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.
